title: SEG Implementation Node
description: Schema for an Implementation node in the Safety Evidence Graph. Sourced from repo B (doxygen comment in .h + function body in .c). Authored by the Software Engineer. Discovered via @safety doxygen tag.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this implementation node. Form: {namespaceBase}/impl/{functionName}. Function name is the locator only — not a semantic anchor. A rename that leaves doxygen comment and @implements tags intact does not change the evidence. Maps to spdxId on SPDX export.

type.description: Fixed SEG type. No direct SPDX equivalent — maps to spdx:Artifact on SPDX export.

name.description: Function name. Used as the locator for the extractor. Must match the identifier in spdxId.

seg:apiHash.description: Hash of the doxygen comment in the .h header file — the API design (intent). A change to this sub-hash triggers a notification: 'the declared intent of this implementation changed — review whether it still satisfies the requirement.'

seg:bodyHash.description: Hash of the function body in the .c source file — the implementation (execution). A change to this sub-hash triggers a notification: 'the execution of this implementation changed — a new test run is likely needed.'

seg:nodeHash.description: Aggregate hash of this node's content. Computed as H(apiHash || bodyHash). A change to either sub-hash produces a new nodeHash and marks all outgoing implements edges suspect.

seg:merkleHash.description: Merkle hash for this node. Computed by the proof generator as H(nodeHash || sorted(merkleHash of dependencies via strong-propagation edges)). Absent until the first proof generation run that includes this node.

seg:sourceRepo.description: Source repository for this node. Fixed to repoB for all Implementation nodes. Resolves to the concrete repo URL defined in config.json.

seg:sourcePath.description: Relative paths within repo B to the source files for this function. Split into header (doxygen comment) and body (function implementation) because they feed separate sub-hashes.

header.description: Relative path to the .h file containing the doxygen comment and @safety tag.

body.description: Relative path to the .c file containing the function body.

comment.description: Optional free-text note. Not part of the node content and not included in nodeHash computation.
